headline: IMF Delivers $377 Million to Ecuador and Will Grant an Additional Loan
summary: The International Monetary Fund is disbursing $377 million to Ecuador and will grant a further loan. Ecuador owes the fund about $2.34 billion and has had more than 20 IMF programs since 1961.
why: The IMF is the global lender of last resort for stressed sovereigns, and its program disbursements signal financing support and policy conditions for countries like Ecuador.
original_headline: FMI entrega 377 millones de dólares a Ecuador y concederá un préstamo adicional
